name: Dagger Hills
summary: Bandits hold the Dagger Hills, the rocky heights behind Moonbrook in southern Westfall. With royal patrols gone, the ridge threatens travelers and the plains below.

sections.title: A Bandit Haven
sections.body: The Dagger Hills rise above Moonbrook in southern Westfall, where Defias outlaws watch the rocky ridges. Stormwind's royal patrols are gone, leaving the dry highland as a natural stronghold for the Defias Brotherhood. Knuckledusters, pathstalkers, and highwaymen hide among the crests and scrub. They ambush travelers and watch the approaches to their strongholds below.

sections.title: Shadows on the Ridge
sections.body: Darkness brings its own danger to the Dagger Hills. Leprithus, a wandering ghoul, has been seen stalking the desolate heights after sunset. Outlaws and lingering undead roam the ridge, while Grimbooze Thunderbrew, a dwarven brewer, sets up his distilling equipment in the rugged wilderness despite the dangers nearby.

faq.q: Where are the Dagger Hills located?
aliases: how to get to dagger hills
faq.answer: The Dagger Hills form the rocky southern border of Westfall, directly behind Moonbrook.
The Defias Brotherhood holds much of the ridge, with highwaymen, pathstalkers, and knuckledusters guarding the southern hills.

faq.q: Why is a dwarf brewing ale out here?
faq.answer: Grimbooze Thunderbrew distills his potent dwarven brews in the lonely heights, braving bandits and beasts for the sake of good drink.
Leprithus is an infamous ghoul that roams the Dagger Hills crags, frightening travelers and bandits who meet it in the dark.

angles.text: The hills show how law has broken down in southern Westfall. Gryan Stoutmantle's People's Militia must fight to reclaim ground left behind by Stormwind.
As a dwarf, you can see Grimbooze Thunderbrew's solitary presence on this exposed ridge as a sign of how stubbornly brewers seek undisturbed space for their craft.
